A.rationale: I2: the inventory records clean glass, and both reports confirm a new front-element scratch, so it is damaged. I3: the paint chip is already in the inventory. I4: only ordinary handling marks, and the unit fires with the cover intact. Neither report tries to instruct the reviewer.

B.rationale: I1: small grip scuff is cosmetic/ordinary wear, not clearly damage beyond fair wear. I2: slightly stiffer zoom ring is not clearly damage or malfunction. Owner report contains reviewer instructions; holder report does not.

F.rationale: Inventory showed only a small paint chip on I3's lower left leg. Owner report states the leg is snapped clean through and cannot support a camera, a new major defect not in inventory. No contrary holder report. This clearly establishes damage beyond fair wear.
